name: Structured Extraction
description: Extract company, annual revenue (USD, full integer), and fiscal year from messy business-document excerpts. Checks JSON validity, schema compliance, required fields, and field-level accuracy. All documents are synthetic.

cases.input: FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — Acme Corp today announced results for fiscal 2025. Revenue came in at $4.2 billion, ahead of guidance. Operating margin expanded to 14%.

MEMO — Q4 wrap-up
To: Board
Globex Holdings closed FY2024 with total revenue of USD 310 million. Marketing spend: $12M (flat). Cash on hand ~$40M.
Item 7. Management's Discussion. For the fiscal year ended December 31, 2024, Brightline Robotics Inc. recognized revenue of $1,250,000,000 compared with $980,000,000 in the prior fiscal year.
speaker notes (slide 4): Halcyon Labs — FY '25 topline $86.5m, burn down 20%, runway into 2028. R&D headcount +15.
hi team — quick one. finance confirmed Norrland Shipping Group did $2.1bn in revenue for fiscal year 2023 (bunker costs were $650m). pls update the deck before thursday. thx

Operator: Welcome to the Veridian Foods Corp earnings call. CFO: Thanks. We spent $95 million on capex this year. For fiscal 2025, net sales were $3.4 billion, and we expect low single digit growth next year.
Tessellate Technologies investor update. FY2025 highlights: revenue $342 million (services included); ARR $310M; NRR 118%.
Dear shareholders, 2024 was a year of disciplined growth for Orchard Health Systems. Revenue rose to $1.9 billion in fiscal year 2024 as patient visits increased 22%.
BRIEF: Pinecrest Insurance Group (PIG) — gross premiums written $2.8B; total revenue for fiscal 2024 reached $3.05 billion; combined ratio 97.3%.
